title: Overture #1 2 Lot Innovation All-American Comics 1990 Sputnik Lunatic Fringe
condition_description: Both covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Overture! #1 and #2 (1990), Innovation / All-American Comics. Original $2.25 cover price each.

You get both issues:
- #1 "16 Tons" cover by George Broderick, featuring the Lunatic Fringe, Sputnik and Blatherskite - back cover: Sputnik "The Space Ghost's Treasure!" art
- #2 "Sputnik Fights Alone!" - back cover: Innovation "Holding a High Standard" ad

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
